title: Modernization planning can align platform change with service continuity, maintainability, and delivery priorities
subtitle: Three hypothetical planning scenarios show the evidence and measures teams can validate before selecting a modernization path.
scenario_1_challenge: A customer-facing application has fragmented dependencies and a release process that makes routine changes difficult to plan.
scenario_1_value_hypothesis: Assess security, maintainability, and release risk before defining a target architecture or delivery sequence.
scenario_2_challenge: A growing integration estate connects operational systems with customer and partner services across several business units.
scenario_2_value_hypothesis: Map critical service dependencies and sequence transition options around operational continuity and ownership.
scenario_3_challenge: Customer reporting depends on manual preparation across a legacy platform, creating questions about scalability and support effort.
scenario_3_value_hypothesis: Trace data lineage and reporting steps, then validate service, control, and operating-cost measures.
scenario_disclosure: Illustrative scenarios only; all outcomes and measures require validation before external use.
